## What the original guide said

::: {.callout-note title="Archived explanation · not independently verified reporting"}
Removes Maryland constitutional criteria governing congressional district boundaries while retaining state legislative district standards. Also lets lawmakers authorize direct review of congressional maps by Maryland’s highest court. Federal requirements still apply.

**Original recommendation: NO.** This records Everett’s pre-election position, not the election result. The archive retains the full reasoning.
:::

[Read the ballot guide](../guide/index.qmd#question-3).
